summary: frag_color_pack (0x97, len10): the raw 24-bit "fmt_word" [56:24] is NOT an inert attachment-format constant (prior hypothesis) — splice-and-observe on the A18 render harness proves it is a live per-component SOURCE-PRESENT + GATE/SELECT + SCALE descriptor for the two packed components. Resolved into three typed bytes (byte+7 present-mask, byte+8 gate/select, byte+9 scale/enable), symmetric across both pack ops (pack1=R,G / pack2=B,A), with byte+7==0xff a hard GPU fault. frag_pos_read (byte0==0x04, len8): UNRESOLVED by splice and confirmed MIS-NAMED on live hardware — it materializes from NONE of 7 distinct own-MSL provocations. Every fragment position/facing/interp builtin lowers to get_sr (special-register read, 4B) + iter/iter_at (interpolation), never the 8-byte 0x04 residue. As a bonus the REAL mechanism was splice-validated: get_sr byte+1 selects the special register and [[front_facing]] reads SR 0xc5. Device work isolated in ~/cleanroom_work/splice_frag/; 0 reboots (only contained CMDBUF faults).

Tokenizing 7 distinct own-compiled A18 shaders yields ZERO frag_pos_read decodes: (1) [[position]] -> get_sr(sr=0xa0/0xa1)+iter; (2) [[front_facing]] -> get_sr(sr=0xc5)+icmp; (3) [[centroid_perspective]]+[[sample_perspective]] varyings -> iter_at(0xaf)+iter(0x2f); (4) [[sample_id]]+[[barycentric_coord]] -> iter(0x2f); (5) float simd_product/simd_prefix_exclusive_sum/simd_broadcast_first+cos -> get_sr+device_load; (6) int simd_product/simd_prefix_exclusive_product/quad_shuffle/quad_broadcast/simd_shuffle_xor; (7) ray-query intersection_query getters (distance/primitive_id/geometry_id). summary: Splice-and-observe on live A18 (T8140/G17P) resolved raw fields for 4 of 5 halfint ops; the 5th (falu2_ext8b) is a corroborated negative. iunary: the popcount/find_msb/reverse sub-op is selected by (byte0 bit7 fn_hi + byte+1 form), NOT by the byte+4 "optype" (splicing 0x02->0x03 keeps popcount) — this corrects the ibitcount/iunary correlation-labelling. Its operand[24:40] raw field decomposes into dst(byte+3,reg<<1), src(byte+5,reg<<2), a source descriptor (byte+6, 0x00=passthrough), and marker bytes, all HW-validated. half_alu (0x10 6B): byte+3 retyped srcB->srcA (the negatable source; -a+b confirmed), byte+4=srcB, byte+5=source modifier/control with bit3=srcA-negate. half_alu_ext8 (0x10 8B): saturate/output-clamp isolated to byte+7 bit1 (0x82 clamps 9->1, 0x80 passes 9), byte+7 bit7=op-valid marker; opsel gains 6=hfma. half_alu_fma12 (0x10 12B) REFINED from pure-negative to POSITIVE: fma(abs(a),b,c) genuinely compiles to a clean 12-byte 0x10 op followed by the store — the 0x10 family is length-polymorphic (6=add/mul, 8=fma or add+sat, 10=fma+sat, 12=fma+abs). falu2_ext8b (opsel 0/1): splicing a working fadd/fma to opsel 0/1/2/3 yields 0 in both 6B and 8B forms => opsel-top-bit-clear is a distinct non-arithmetic class; clean own-MSL only emits such tokens inside the complex ldexp lowering adjacent to another op-leader, corroborating the descriptor's over-consumption flag. 0 reboots; device healthy.

resolved.provenance: HW-VALIDATED (splice A18 EXP-M4-14): REFINES the prior pure-negative. fma(abs(a),b,c) genuinely compiles to a clean 12-byte 0x10 op `10 02 1e 03 83 04 00 00 00 80 01 00` @main+0x20, cleanly FOLLOWED by the e7 store (not over-consumption). Runs correctly: a=[-8,-2,-4,-1] b=1 c=[1,2,4,8] -> [9,4,8,9]=fma(|a|,b,c). abs modifier participates in byte+4 (0x81 plain-fma -> 0x83 abs). The 0x10 family is length-polymorphic: 6B=add/mul, 8B=fma or add+saturate, 10B=fma+saturate (`10 02 1e 03 82 04 00 00 00 82`), 12B=fma+abs. Plain fma is 8B, so a fixed 'always 12B for byte0==0x10' length rule over-consumes -- the length must be modifier/opsel-aware (flag for length-rule owner).
